analysis.concept_guess: East Asian casual dining (Japanese / Korean fried chicken and ramen, SIC 56101)
analysis.headline: Two consecutive well-rated Asian dining concepts closed at 14 Rivington St within 22–42 months amid fierce local competition.

hypotheses.reason: Extreme saturation and fierce competition from high-performing neighbours
evidence: 85 Google venues and 42 FSA venues within 150m
High local median Google rating of 4.5 and FSA hygiene median of 5.0
Strong nearby competitors like Blacklock Shoreditch (4.7 rating, 3376 reviews) and YAYACAS (4.8 rating, 720 reviews)
hypotheses.counter_argument: NANASHI SHOREDITCH LIMITED managed to attract 285 reviews with a 4.5 rating over 42 months, proving a viable customer base existed for the site.

hypotheses.reason: Direct product overlap with established local operators
evidence: CHINGU LTD (Korean Fried Chicken & Ramen) closed after 22 months with only 18 reviews
Butchies Shoreditch (a known fried chicken concept, FSA hygiene 5) is located nearby
hypotheses.counter_argument: CHINGU LTD achieved a 4.6 rating, suggesting customers liked the product, and it also offered ramen which differentiates it from pure fried chicken venues.

hypotheses.reason: High operational demands of a 7-day late-night hospitality pitch
evidence: 76% of nearby venues stay open after 21:00 on weekdays and 77% open on Sundays
Average lifespan at this address is 32.0 months across two closures (NANASHI at 42 months, CHINGU at 22 months)
hypotheses.counter_argument: High late-night and Sunday opening shares usually indicate strong 7-day footfall (supported by Old Street Underground Station 380m away), which should benefit revenue rather than cause failure.

analysis.chain_pattern: Two consecutive East Asian restaurant concepts (NANASHI SHOREDITCH LIMITED lasting 42 months and CHINGU LTD lasting 22 months, both SIC 56101) achieved strong ratings (4.5 and 4.6) but failed to survive long-term, with the second operator gaining very little traction (only 18 reviews) and leaving a nearly 3-year gap between tenancies (May 2021 to March 2024).
analysis.caveat: Both entities are confirmed hospitality venues on Google, so this is not an accountant's address. However, CHINGU LTD is noted as 'CLOSED_TEMPORARILY' on Google despite its company dissolution in January 2026, and we have no financial or lease data to confirm if closures were driven by rent hikes.
